description: Update a team member's organization-profile fields: first name, last name, country, timezone, and job title. Only the fields you provide are changed (PATCH semantics). Role changes are not supported here — use the dedicated role-change tool. The organization is fixed by your context — never pass an organization id. You cannot target a user more privileged than yourself.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

org_user_id.description: Id of the OrganizationUser to update.

name: update_user_profile
